fusions.name: Schooling Darts
fusions.desc: Looses a school of 3 darting jets of water, spread apart, each dealing 4 damage, with a 25% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slick Recoil
fusions.desc: Your weapon runs slick with water for one strike that deals 14 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it [Drowning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Eel Skin
fusions.desc: Your dodge chance rises by 25% for 10 seconds, and you restore 10 health.

fusions.name: Never Netted
fusions.desc: Every blow you dodge builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
